code: bg_register_node_kind(handle, "scenario", executor = function(node, inputs) {   node$params })  bg_register_node_kind(handle, "simulate_data", executor = function(node, inputs) {   scenario <- inputs[[1]]   set.seed(scenario$seed + node$params$seed_offset)    n <- scenario$n   z <- rnorm(n)   treatment_prob <- plogis(scenario$assignment_intercept + scenario$confounding * z)   treatment <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = treatment_prob)   outcome <- 0.5 + scenario$beta_treat * treatment + scenario$beta_z * z + rnorm(n, sd = scenario$sigma)    data <- data.frame(     z = z,     treatment = treatment,     outcome = outcome   )    list(     data = data,     truth = list(       beta_treat = scenario$beta_treat,       beta_z = scenario$beta_z,       confounding = scenario$confounding     ),     split = node$params$split   ) })  bg_register_node_kind(handle, "descriptive_check", executor = function(node, inputs) {   sim <- inputs[[1]]   data <- sim$data    treated <- data[data$treatment == 1, , drop = FALSE]   untreated <- data[data$treatment == 0, , drop = FALSE]   pooled_sd <- stats::sd(data$z)    list(     split = sim$split,     treated_share = mean(data$treatment),     mean_z_treated = mean(treated$z),     mean_z_untreated = mean(untreated$z),     z_smd = (mean(treated$z) - mean(untreated$z)) / pooled_sd,     cor_treatment_z = stats::cor(data$treatment, data$z)   ) })  bg_register_node_kind(handle, "fit_lm", executor = function(node, inputs) {   train <- inputs[[1]]   test <- inputs[[2]]   formula <- stats::as.formula(node$params$formula)    fit <- stats::lm(formula, data = train$data)   predictions <- stats::predict(fit, newdata = test$data)   rmse <- sqrt(mean((test$data$outcome - predictions)^2))    estimate <- unname(stats::coef(fit)[["treatment"]])    list(     model_label = node$label,     formula = node$params$formula,     estimate = estimate,     absolute_effect_error = abs(estimate - train$truth$beta_treat),     predictive_rmse = rmse   ) })  bg_register_node_kind(handle, "compare_models", executor = function(node, inputs) {   naive <- inputs[[1]]   adjusted <- inputs[[2]]   descriptive <- inputs[[3]]    ranking <- data.frame(     model = c(naive$model_label, adjusted$model_label),     absolute_effect_error = c(       naive$absolute_effect_error,       adjusted$absolute_effect_error     ),     predictive_rmse = c(naive$predictive_rmse, adjusted$predictive_rmse)   )    ranking <- ranking[order(ranking$absolute_effect_error, ranking$predictive_rmse), ]    list(     imbalance = descriptive,     ranking = ranking,     recommended = ranking$model[[1]]   ) })

250,       beta_treat = 1.0,       beta_z = 0.8,       sigma = 1.0,       assignment_intercept = 0,       confounding = confounding,       seed = seed     )   )    train <- bg_add_node(     handle,     kind = "simulate_data",     label = sprintf("%s train", label),     inputs = scenario,     params = list(split = "train", seed_offset = 1)   )    test <- bg_add_node(     handle,     kind = "simulate_data",     label = sprintf("%s test", label),     inputs = scenario,     params = list(split = "test", seed_offset = 1001)   )    descriptive <- bg_add_node(     handle,     kind = "descriptive_check",     label = sprintf("%s descriptive check", label),     inputs = train   )    naive_fit <- bg_add_node(     handle,     kind = "fit_lm",     label = sprintf("%s naive model", label),     inputs = c(train, test),     params = list(formula = "outcome ~ treatment")   )    adjusted_fit <- bg_add_node(     handle,     kind = "fit_lm",     label = sprintf("%s adjusted model", label),     inputs = c(train, test),     params = list(formula = "outcome ~ treatment + z")   )    compare <- bg_add_node(     handle,     kind = "compare_models",     label = sprintf("%s comparison", label),     inputs = c(naive_fit, adjusted_fit, descriptive)   )    gate <- bg_add_gate(     handle,     from = descriptive,     to = compare,     prompt = sprintf(       "Does the descriptive imbalance in the %s scenario justify relying on the adjustment-aware model?",       label     ),     alternatives = c("yes", "no"),     refs = list(       list(         citekey = "scholz2024causalproxy",         url = "https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.06927"       )     )   )    list(     scenario = scenario,     train = train,     test = test,     descriptive = descriptive,     naive_fit = naive_fit,     adjusted_fit = adjusted_fit,     compare = compare,     gate = gate   ) }  randomized <- build_branch(handle, "Randomized", confounding = 0.0, seed = 101) confounded <- title: bayesgrove 0.7.0
text: bg_cmdstanr_hmc_metrics() now reads num_divergent / num_max_treedepth diagnostic_summary() (divergent / max_treedepth, silently always read zero divergences). E-BFMI handling longer collapses Inf single chain NA; finite chains filtered taking minimum (cmdstanr brms backends). bg_executor_ppc() computes posterior-predictive p-value per-draw margin (apply(yrep, 1, ...)), per-observation margin. PPC statistics restricted allowlist (mean, sd, median, min, max, mad). brms bg_brms_hmc_metrics() computes real per-chain E-BFMI energy__ sampler parameter (raw energy minimum, never comparable threshold); treedepth hits compare configured max_treedepth rather hardcoded 10. brms executors build brm() call via .call NULL args dropped, missing seed longer passes seed = NULL (brms’ default NA). fingerprint now hashes stan_file CONTENTS, path, editing Stan program invalidates cache fixed path. dataless brms::stancode() source-hash branch removed. Mid-run summaries annotated is_fresh = TRUE, freshness-strict workflow packs (fit criticism) see evidence emitted within bg_run() call hold downstream nodes correctly. bg_executor_compare() reports runner-elpd_diff plain-data comparison table (always-zero best-model value); stacking weights use loo::loo_model_weights(method = "stacking") surface errors summary metadata instead silently dropped. bg_executor_loo() computes r_eff via loo::relative_eff() chain-shaped draws, eliminating missing-r_eff warning. built-sbc executor longer evaluates persisted data_fn source. Simulation cases plain data supplied upstream generator executor, project code remains behind bg_restore_executors(trust = TRUE). LOO-PIT now uses weighted posterior::pit() (including reproducible randomized PIT discrete outcomes) dependence-aware PIET uniformity test. SBC ranks bounded bulk ESS graded every chi-squared bin least five expected observations. Graph tree output preserves child indentation, README’s eight-schools example now uses Stan programs shipped package. Parallel dispatch validates minimum versions mirai, purrr, carrier starting. Parallel fit waves warn daemon-local sampler CSV files may durable.

title: bayesgrove 0.7.0
text: bg_use_default_workflow(), bg_use_workflow_packs(), bg_next_actions() reclassified stable bg_api_boundary(). bg_read_decisions() exported: read-accessor decision log, completing reader family alongside bg_read_summaries() registry readers. Workflow packs recognize fit nodes *_fit naming convention (bg_pack_is_fit_node()), cmdstanr_fit brms_fit nodes participate comparison candidacy criticism review; previously literal kind fit , meant comparison loop never fired real backends. Prior-predictive fit kinds excluded candidacy. LOO diagnostic summaries reviewed computation evidence rather fit criticism. ppc node kind supports prop_zero (proportion zeros) test statistic, standard posterior-predictive check zero-heavy count data. Statistics remain allowlist resolved internal functions; params stay data, never code. Registering brms support via bg_use_brms() now also provides neutral data node kind (alias stan_data executor), bg_fit_brms() labels data node . Parallel execution: bg_run() gains parallel argument ("auto"/"never"/"always"). Execution proceeds topological waves; active mirai::daemons() wave independent nodes dispatched concurrently via purrr::in_parallel(). Workers write content-addressed blobs ; main process remains single writer artifact index, summaries, jobs. Protocol holds bg_pause() apply wave boundaries. mirai, carrier, purrr soft dependencies; sequential path works without . New built-node kinds loo_pit (PSIS-LOO PIT calibration graded dependence-aware uniformity test) sbc (simulation-based calibration graded chi-squared rank-uniformity test), closing gap workflow packs ask shipped executors can produce. ppc executor now stores plot-ready data (observed y plus capped yrep subsample) artifact. Visualization: bg_graph_mermaid() renders active graph Mermaid flowchart text state coloring, bg_plot() plots node’s diagnostics (ppc density overlay, LOO-PIT ECDF, SBC rank histogram, fit traces) via soft bayesplot dependency. bg_export_report() embeds Mermaid graph output formats. Practitioner shortcuts bg_fit_stan() bg_fit_brms() collapse data-node + fit-node + run sequence one call (experimental). bg_bundle() records reproducibility manifest (R version, platform, package versions, CmdStan version) bundle; bg_open() warns restored bundle produced different environment. bg_next_actions() results blocked bg_run() handles print protocol-aware checklists: held nodes show hold reason, obligations render severity glyphs copy-pasteable resolving call. New ?bayesgrove-concepts help topic vignette("concepts"): node -> summary -> obligation -> decision -> hold mental model one place. bg_branch() gains continue argument absorbs bg_branch_with_continuation(): continue = TRUE clones immediate children onto branch, character vector clones children kinds, returned record always carries $continuation_nodes. bg_branch_with_continuation() deprecated (warns per session, keeps legacy return shape, classified deprecated bg_api_boundary()) removed future release. bg_update_node() now merges params existing set via utils::modifyList() instead replacing whole list; pass replace = TRUE intentional wholesale replacement. Added inst/CITATION (package + Gelman et al. 2020, “Bayesian Workflow”). bg_set_node_data() attaches R data object node via content-addressed store, preserving types JSON serialization mangle (e.g. Stan integers). Project-level workflow_strictness config key: packs without explicit per-ref strictness inherit project default (e.g. "advisory").
